notes.note: The seal service's runs moved from :00 and :30 to :25 and :55 Eastern (release 3988ffc4, PR #95). Tips are on the hour or half hour, so a game's last seal is now taken about 5 minutes before its scheduled tip instead of 30, after most game-time injury decisions. The rule for which seal a game uses (the newest captured before ESPN's scheduled tip-off), the seal's contents and both models are unchanged. It applies to both the Original and the Market-informed model.
